title: ChoreoStudio: Planning What, When, and Who in Music-Driven Group Choreography
summary: Music-driven group dance generation must decide not only how each dancer moves, but also what formation the group should form, when it should change, and who should execute each transition. Existing methods can generate orderly and rhythmically synchronized group motion, but remain limited in formation evolution and inter-dancer interaction. In human choreography, formation transitions often align with changes in high-level musical structure, such as the progression from an introduction to a chorus or from a chorus to a climax. We present ChoreoStudio, which makes choreography planning explicit. A music disentangler first decomposes the audio into frame-level rhythmic features and segment-level structural features. Given the segment-level features and sparse labels, a frozen omni-modal model acts as a scriptwriter, producing a global semantic description that guides the Director's choreography planning. Based on this context, the Director produces three coupled interaction decisions: a centroid-relative point set specifies what formation to produce, a transition gate determines when it should change, and a mobility allocation indicates who should execute the transition. The transition gate and mobility allocation are further conditioned on the planned geometric change, coupling formation targets with their temporal and dancer-specific execution. At a finer temporal scale, frame-aligned music features condition the diffusion generator to control detailed body motion and preserve beat-level alignment. The segment-level interaction plan is injected in parallel through frame-aligned instruction tokens and cross-dancer attention biases, coordinating how the generator realizes each transition. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChoreoStudio follows the planned interactions while achieving state-of-the-art performance in motion quality, group organization, and formation dynamics.

title: DeformStruct: Deformable Structure Modeling for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point-supervised Temporal Action Localization (PTAL) aims to localize action instances using only a single annotated timestamp for each instance. Such sparse supervision offers limited guidance for modeling the structural organization of an action instance. Existing PTAL methods primarily infer action regions from classification responses, leaving the structural organization of multiple action-related parts within each instance insufficiently modeled. To address this problem, we propose DeformStruct, an instance-level deformable structure modeling framework for PTAL. DeformStruct progressively constructs the structure of each action instance through three stages. First, Structural Anchor Mining discovers multiple anchors from annotated points and action-responsive regions, providing structural nodes grounded in the current instance. Second, Deformable Part Alignment associates latent structural parts with these anchors through deformation-aware matching, allowing their temporal supports to adapt to instance-dependent variations. Third, Relational Structural Organization explicitly models the relative temporal relations among the aligned parts, forming a relational representation that characterizes how different action-related parts are organized together. Extensive experiments on THUMOS14, ActivityNet-v1.3, GTEA, and BEOID demonstrate consistent improvements in point-supervised temporal localization and validate the effectiveness of deformable structural modeling.

summary_zh: 点监督时序动作定位（Point-supervised Temporal Action Localization, PTAL）旨在仅利用每个动作实例的一个标注时间戳来定位动作实例。这种稀疏监督为建模动作实例的结构组织提供了有限的指导。现有的PTAL方法主要从分类响应中推断动作区域，导致每个实例内多个动作相关部分的结构组织未被充分建模。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DeformStruct，一个面向PTAL的实例级可变形结构建模框架。DeformStruct通过三个阶段逐步构建每个动作实例的结构。首先，结构锚点挖掘（Structural Anchor Mining）从标注点和动作响应区域中发现多个锚点，提供以当前实例为基础的结构节点。其次，可变形部件对齐（Deformable Part Alignment）通过变形感知匹配将潜在结构部件与这些锚点关联起来，使其时间支撑能够适应实例相关的变化。第三，关系结构组织（Relational Structural Organization）显式地建模已对齐部件之间的相对时序关系，形成一种表征不同动作相关部件如何被组织在一起的关系表示。在THUMOS14、ActivityNet-v1.3、GTEA和BEOID上的大量实验表明，点监督时序定位取得了一致的提升，并验证了可变形结构建模的有效性。

title: ViT-H: Generative Video-To-Humanoid Control with Motion Tracking Feedback
summary: Learning humanoid control from monocular human videos offers a scalable way to acquire diverse whole-body behaviors. Yet, existing reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines are limited in system-level scalability by separately optimized intermediate stages and cannot directly optimize reference motion executability using downstream tracking feedback. We present ViT-H, a video-to-humanoid control framework following a generation-and-tracking paradigm. ViT-H directly generates humanoid reference motions from videos with a diffusion model, bypassing human motion reconstruction and retargeting, and uses motion-tracking outcomes to post-train the generator with direct preference optimization. We further introduce an autoregressive variant that enables real-time humanoid video teleoperation with sub-400 ms latency. Extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 demonstrate that ViT-H outperforms state-of-the-art reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines in both motion quality and executability. We further show that ViT-H scales favorably with model size and with both pre-training and post-training data scale, while motion-tracking feedback consistently improves executability across different motion trackers.

title: DisPOSE: Projected Polystochastic Diffusion for Self-Supervised Multi-View 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Recovering 3D human poses for multiple individuals from different camera views is a fundamental bottleneck for analyzing interacting behaviors. Existing self-supervised approaches leverage synthetic catalogues of 3D poses; however, this leads to poor generalization in real-world scenarios due to distribution shifts. We therefore introduce DisPOSE, a self-supervised framework that approximates the inherently discrete multi-view person-assignment problem as a generative diffusion process over the space of polystochastic tensors. By employing differentiable Sinkhorn projections during denoising, our model learns to guide solutions toward valid and feasible assignments based on 2D image priors. The complete 3D skeletons of localized individuals are then regressed using a Hypergraph-Convolutional Decoder that explicitly models relational structures and articulated joints across multiple views. The proposed approach outperforms current state-of-the-art self-supervised methods on standard datasets and demonstrates strong performance on a newly proposed benchmark featuring highly occluded scenes from surgical operating rooms. Our diffusion-based localization demonstrates high label efficiency, retaining 99% of its performance with only 10% of the pseudo-labels. Notably, disentangling the assignment and root regression components while maintaining differentiability makes DisPOSE nearly agnostic to different camera arrangements. Project site and code: https://wngtn.github.io/DisPOSE/

summary_zh: 从不同相机视角恢复多个个体的3D人体姿态是分析交互行为的一个根本性瓶颈。现有的自监督方法利用合成的3D姿态目录；然而，由于分布偏移，这导致在真实世界场景中的泛化能力较差。因此，我们提出了DisPOSE，一个自监督框架，将本质上离散的多视角人员分配问题近似为多随机张量空间上的生成式扩散过程。通过在去噪过程中采用可微的Sinkhorn投影，我们的模型学习基于2D图像先验将解引导至有效且可行的分配。随后，使用超图卷积解码器回归已定位个体的完整3D骨架，该解码器显式地建模跨多个视角的关系结构和铰接关节。所提出的方法在标准数据集上优于当前最先进的自监督方法，并在一个新提出的、包含手术室中高度遮挡场景的基准上展现出强大的性能。我们基于扩散的定位表现出较高的标签效率，仅使用10%的伪标签即可保留99%的性能。值得注意的是，在保持可微性的同时解耦分配与根节点回归组件，使DisPOSE几乎不受不同相机布置的影响。项目网站与代码：https://wngtn.github.io/DisPOSE/

title: Compatible Likelihoods for Flow Matching on Manifolds
summary: On the simplest non-Euclidean manifold, the 1D flat torus, we exhibit a distribution where a recently proposed extension of Riemannian flow matching is globally optimized by a velocity field that pushes samples away from the data distribution. We trace this failure mode to a property we call compatibility; a likelihood-based flow matching objective is compatible if its population minimizer recovers the marginal velocity field induced by the data and coupling. We give a general condition for compatibility, apply it to existing methods, and bound the worst-case error in terms of a residual component vanishing under compatibility. Next, we note that existing compatible objectives put density on velocities that are infeasible on compact manifolds. We propose an objective built from an exponential family over endpoints, with the conditional velocity as sufficient statistic, which is both compatible and supported only on feasible velocities. This manifests as a reweighting of the flow matching loss which, on constant-curvature manifolds, treats errors in flow speed and direction differently. Empirically, our method recovers the correct velocity field on the test case, outperforms prior methods on high-dimensional product tori, and obtains substantial NLL improvements over prior work on two of four standard geospatial benchmarks on the sphere at moderate runtime overhead. On a large dataset of high-dimensional human poses, our method outperforms prior work according to sample-based metrics.

AI.method: 作者引入"兼容性"概念：若似然型流匹配目标的总体最小化解能恢复由数据与耦合诱导的边际速度场，则称其兼容。给出兼容性的一般条件并应用于现有方法，同时用随兼容性消失的残差分量界定最坏情况误差。进一步指出现有兼容目标会把密度放在紧流形上不可行的速度上，因此提出基于端点指数族的目标，以条件速度为充分统计量，既兼容又仅支持可行速度；该目标表现为流匹配损失的重新加权，在常曲率流形上对流速误差与方向误差区别对待。
AI.result: 在测试用例上，所提方法恢复了正确的速度场；在高维乘积环面上优于先前方法；在四个标准球面地理空间基准中的两个上，以适度的运行时间开销获得了显著的NLL改进；在大型高维人体姿态数据集上，按基于样本的指标优于先前工作。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配目标在流形上的有效性取决于兼容性，且还需保证速度的可行性；所提出的基于端点指数族的兼容且可行目标有效解决了现有方法的失败模式，并在环面、球面及高维人体姿态等多个任务上取得实证改进。

summary_zh: 在最简单的非欧几里得流形——一维平坦环面上，我们展示了一个分布，其中最近提出的黎曼流匹配扩展被一个将样本推离数据分布的速度场全局优化。我们将这一失效模式追溯到一个我们称之为相容性的性质；一个基于似然的流匹配目标，如果其总体最小化器恢复了由数据和耦合所诱导的边缘速度场，则该目标是相容的。我们给出了相容性的一般条件，将其应用于现有方法，并以在相容性下消失的残差分量来界定最坏情况误差。接下来，我们注意到现有的相容目标将密度置于在紧流形上不可行的速度上。我们提出了一个由端点上的指数族构建的目标，以条件速度作为充分统计量，该目标既相容又仅支撑在可行速度上。这表现为对流匹配损失的一种重新加权，在常曲率流形上，它对流速误差和流向误差区别对待。在经验上，我们的方法在测试用例上恢复了正确的速度场，在高维乘积环面上优于先前方法，并在球面上的四个标准地理空间基准中的两个上，以适度的运行时间开销获得了相对于先前工作的显著负对数似然改进。在一个大规模高维人体姿态数据集上，我们的方法根据基于样本的指标优于先前工作。

title: EMG Tokenization Preserves Movement Information at a Fraction of the Bitrate
summary: Wireless electromyography (EMG) interfaces must balance electrode coverage against transmission bandwidth. Here, we show that compact EMG tokens substantially reduce payload while retaining information for three-dimensional hand-pose decoding. We evaluate two causal tokenizers fitted without pose labels: an encoder pretrained to reconstruct EMG spectra and one based on SPAR, an engineered spectral-spatial representation of neighbouring electrodes. In personalized, within-session experiments with 320-channel EMG from nine participants, we compare tokenized and continuous features using matched decoder architectures and training procedures. Averaged across decoders, tokenization changed mean error by +0.01 mm for SPAR (95% confidence interval: -0.12 to 0.14) and +0.45 mm for the learned representation (0.10 to 0.82). Both increases met a 1 mm non-inferiority criterion. Stored token arrays reduced payloads 41-fold relative to raw EMG and 36-fold relative to continuous SPAR features. On sampled windows of the public emg2pose benchmark's test partition, absolute differences in mean error between learned tokens and continuous features were below 0.05 mm across 176 participants and in the subset of 20 participants unseen during training. Electrode coverage, calibration, and unseen recordings affected SPAR decoding more than quantization did. In a computational benchmark, optimized SPAR generated tokens for 63 channels within 20 ms on a Cortex-M55 microcontroller. These findings support tokenization as a compact interface between wearable sensing and movement decoding, allowing decoders to be updated while the wearable encoder and transmitted representation remain fixed.
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures; 12-page supplement included. Supplementary Data 1-9 (CSV) are provided as ancillary files

relevance.label: maybe
relevance.reason: 该工作聚焦EMG信号的手部姿态解码与可穿戴传感压缩，属于手部运动而非全身运动，但EMG运动解码与可穿戴运动感知方法可能迁移到运动数据采集。

AI.tldr: 本文提出用紧凑的EMG token替代原始或连续特征传输，在保持三维手势解码精度的同时将数据量降低约36–41倍，并验证了其在微控制器上的实时可行性。
AI.motivation: 无线肌电接口需要在电极覆盖范围与传输带宽之间权衡；原始EMG或连续特征数据量大，制约可穿戴设备的传输与解码器更新，因此需要一种低带宽且信息无损的紧凑表示。
AI.method: 作者评估了两种无需姿态标签即可训练的因果tokenizer：一种是预训练用于重建EMG频谱的编码器（学习型表示），另一种是基于SPAR的工程化频谱-空间表示（利用相邻电极）。在9名受试者、320通道EMG的个性化会话内实验中，用匹配的解码器架构和训练流程对比token化特征与连续特征；并在公开emg2pose基准的176名受试者（含20名训练未见者）上验证泛化性，同时在Cortex-M55微控制器上测试63通道token生成的实时性。
AI.result: 平均误差变化：SPAR为+0.01 mm（95% CI: -0.12至0.14），学习型表示为+0.45 mm（0.10至0.82），两者均满足1 mm非劣效性标准。存储的token数组相对原始EMG减少41倍、相对连续SPAR特征减少36倍。在emg2pose测试集上，学习型token与连续特征的绝对误差差低于0.05 mm。电极覆盖、校准和未见记录对SPAR解码的影响大于量化本身。优化后的SPAR可在Cortex-M55上于20 ms内为63通道生成token。
AI.conclusion: token化可作为可穿戴传感与运动解码之间的紧凑接口，在保持解码精度的同时大幅降低传输负载，并支持在可穿戴编码器和传输表示保持固定的情况下更新解码器。

summary_zh: 无线肌电图（EMG）接口必须在电极覆盖范围与传输带宽之间取得平衡。在此，我们表明紧凑的EMG令牌在保留三维手部姿态解码信息的同时，大幅降低了有效载荷。我们评估了两种在无姿态标签条件下拟合的因果令牌化器：一种是为重建EMG频谱而预训练的编码器，另一种基于SPAR——一种针对相邻电极设计的频谱-空间表示。在九名参与者、320通道EMG的个性化会话内实验中，我们使用匹配的解码器架构和训练流程，对令牌化特征与连续特征进行了比较。在解码器间取平均后，令牌化使SPAR的平均误差改变了+0.01 mm（95%置信区间：-0.12至0.14），使学习表示的平均误差改变了+0.45 mm（0.10至0.82）。两种增加均满足1 mm的非劣效性标准。存储的令牌阵列相对于原始EMG将有效载荷降低了41倍，相对于连续SPAR特征降低了36倍。在公开的emg2pose基准测试集测试分区的采样窗口上，学习令牌与连续特征之间的平均误差绝对差值在176名参与者中均低于0.05 mm，在训练期间未见过的20名参与者子集中同样如此。电极覆盖范围、校准和未见过的记录对SPAR解码的影响大于量化。在一项计算基准测试中，优化后的SPAR在Cortex-M55微控制器上于20 ms内为63个通道生成了令牌。这些发现支持将令牌化作为可穿戴传感与运动解码之间的紧凑接口，使得在可穿戴编码器和传输表示保持固定的情况下，解码器仍可更新。
